{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders identified: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Confirm removal
print(f"New dataset shape after removing QA orders: {sales_clean.shape}")

# Also remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Final dataset: only completed orders, no QA orders
sales_final = sales_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()
print(f"Final dataset shape: {sales_final.shape}")"}
